# Keep workspace data consistent if the browser closes during restore

## What & Why
The restore flow writes several browser-storage collections. A browser close during that operation could otherwise leave profile, answers, and applications from different workspace versions.

## Done looks like
- Add coverage for an interrupted restore or equivalent storage-write failure
- Ensure reopening the browser shows either the previous complete workspace or the restored complete workspace
- Never expose a mixed partial restore to the user

- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/lib/storage.ts
